d:
Kya aapne shravni mele ki bhakti, aastha, sanskriti aur adbhut vyavasthaon ko apne kaimre men kaid kiya hai? ab samay hai apni rachnatmakta ko pahchan dilane ka!
"shravni mela – Influencer Eye Contest" men bhag len aur apne kaimre ki nazar se mahadev ki is divy yatra ko duniya ke samne prastut karen. apni behatrin ril ya vidiyo sajha karen aur banen bihar paryatan ke sath is aadhyatmik utsav ki prernadayak aavaza. aaie, shraddha, sanskriti aur bihar ki anupam virasat ko apni nazron se duniya tak pahunchaen.
